name: Watch a competitor
when: The founder names a competitor to keep an eye on, or asks what changed at one.
procedure: Crawl their site once with crawl_site from the home page.
From the map, note the addresses of their pricing, changelog and careers pages. Say which of the three you could not find.
Watch those pages with watch_page, one call each, saying in "what" what to look out for.
When a change arrives in this conversation, write one line in the Launch plan or the Profile doc: the date, what changed, and the link.
Tell the founder in one sentence why it matters, or that it does not.
pitfalls: Crawl once. Watching is what keeps you up to date, not crawling again.
Do not watch the home page: it changes for reasons that mean nothing.
A change is what the page says now, not what the competitor will do. Do not guess their plans.
verify: Up to three pages are watched, each named in list_watches, and every change that arrived has one dated line with its link in the doc.
